name: Cemetery gatehouse

layers.essential_history: [[c:The cemetery gatehouse has a plaque that we think shows 1926. We're still checking.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Village cemeteries like this often opened once the churchyard was getting full, and a gatehouse was a tidy way to mark the entrance. That's our best guess for Warmington, and we haven't checked it yet.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: the way home passes through a quiet place. Look at the gatehouse, not the graves.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head north for about 350 metres to Big Green Pocket Park. Head back towards the village. Keep to the pavements and paths, and look from the road only.]]
notes: Use the entrance plaque only. Do not use gravestones or names.
